protocol.selection: For each history/domain/decision, replay earlier forecasts at their own origins and labels at the decision cutoff. Select the latest three strictly earlier origins where the current reference has all target labels scored. Every candidate must forecast now and score on those exact same three folds. Minimize mean per-fold MAE; differences within 1e-10 tie, preferring current then ascending months. With fewer than three folds retain current. If current cannot forecast now, retain its abstention; never bypass current support rules. No final target labels, family or seed enter selection.
protocol.targets: Three calendar months following each origin; quarterly satisfaction scores only the final quarter-end month. Preserve known hiring zeros, complete all-opening 90-day follow-up and report lags. Preserve survey identity and missing/suppressed waves.
protocol.comparison: Fixed current trend comparator versus prior-validation selector, plus every simpler current-method baseline. Report paired mean per-case MAE and mean per-case RMSE where supported, selection counts, all abstentions, family and origin strata, aggregate per-domain metrics and worst-family and worst-family-origin means. Hiring uses existing opening-weighted per-case metrics. Repeated origins and families share histories and are not independent trials; no significance claim.
protocol.recommendationRule: No automatic promotion. Retain current if the selector fails to lower paired aggregate MAE or worsens any family-origin paired mean, or reduces availability. Even passing only warrants separate review, not proven robustness.
protocol.custody: Freeze protocol and implementation before generating untouched seeds. Fit each window and select solely from releases available at each decision; final scoring occurs only after the policy decision. Preserve the previous history-length study as exploratory evidence. No tuning or further model complexity after this result.
limitations: Sixty-month candidates may lack three mature historical validation folds; this tests an eligibility-constrained policy, not a fully powered contest of all windows.
Survey L36 can lack comparable earlier folds because of persistent old missing waves.
Only June 2026 crosses the fixed July reversal; earlier origins cannot establish repeated shock robustness.
Stable turnover includes seasonality and changing workforce stock; hiring timing improvement generally leaves 90-day success probability stable.
One new synthetic sample cannot establish real-world performance or historical availability.
protocol.reserve: No October–December 2026 target periods/cohorts scored; hiring follow-up can overlap those calendar dates.

guardDescription: December-only abstention guard at November cutoff; no validation folds or accuracy comparison. Current forecast failures must remain policy failures.
aggregation: Paired mean per-decision metrics; mean history RMSE is not pooled RMSE. Origins and families are dependent repeated scenarios, not independent trials. Missing scores never become zero error.
